name: create_ts_generic_dedupe
description: Writes a generic key-based dedupe preserving first occurrence, fully typed
prompts: Create dedupe.ts exporting a generic function dedupeBy<T, K>(items: T[], key: (item: T) => K): T[] that returns the items with duplicates removed, keeping the FIRST occurrence of each key, in original order. It must compile under `tsc --strict`, preserve the element type T (no any), and not mutate the input array.

test_setup_files.run_checks.sh:
set -e
tsc --strict --target es2020 --module commonjs --skipLibCheck --noEmit dedupe.ts type_tests.ts
tsc --strict --target es2020 --module commonjs --skipLibCheck --outDir build dedupe.ts
node behavior_test.js
